answer_1.quote: Our survey provides an up-to-date account of the field in the age of LLMs, an additional focus on humour explanation, and suggestions for future work based on real-world ethical considerations, rather than solely technical innovations. This survey is structured around the two primary generative tasks in computational humour. In §3 we explore humour generation, broken down by humour type, whilst in §4 we explore humour explanation, broken down into explanation through classification (see §4.1) and natural language explanation (see §4.2).
models: Llama models distilled from Deepseek R1
answer_1.outputs: Puns, jokes, satirical headlines, hyperbolic phrases, tongue twisters, memes, humor explanations.
